access.question: Do I need to install a program to use Orthovet?
access.answer: No. Orthovet is accessed through your browser. Sign in to organize cases and work with images without installing a program on your computer. An internet connection is required.

images.question: Which radiograph formats can I use?
images.answer: Image import supports DICOM (.dcm and .dicom), PNG and JPEG (.jpg and .jpeg) files. After adding a radiograph to a case, you can open the image to calibrate it and begin placing markings.

calibration.question: How does image calibration work?
calibration.answer: You enter a known dimension and place its reference points on the radiograph. Calibration establishes the relationship between pixels and that dimension so measurements use the scale defined for the image.

saving.question: Can I save my planning and continue later?
saving.answer: Yes. You can save the markings and resume planning when you reopen the case. Check the save confirmation before leaving the workspace to make sure your changes have been recorded.

tools.question: Which planning tools does the platform offer?
tools.answer: Orthovet includes distance, angle and circle tools, as well as features for defining axes, organizing surgical planning references and simulating adjustments on a radiograph. The resource pages explain each of these possibilities.

audience.question: Who is Orthovet designed for?
audience.answer: For veterinarians working with orthopedic planning who want to bring patient data, radiographs and analysis references together in one workspace. The platform supports case organization, the creation of markings and planning review.
